# CVForge

> CVForge is a free CV builder that runs entirely in the browser. Fill in a form, pick one of six templates, check the document against applicant tracking systems and print one A4 page. There is no account and nothing is uploaded.

## Pages

- [Home and builder (English)](https://cvforge.dawidolko.pl/): the CV builder, template gallery and FAQ
- [Home and builder (Polish)](https://cvforge.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the same page in Polish

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
